description: This PHP source file defines the ChannelProjectsAdminController class, which manages administrative actions related to channel projects in the Goteo application. It includes route definitions, CRUD operations for listing, adding, and deleting project associations with channels, and form creation logic.

classes.name: ChannelProjectsAdminController
classes.description: Controller class managing admin operations for channel projects including listing, adding, and deleting projects associated with channels.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name 'channels' for route organization.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Defines and returns route collection for listing, deleting, and adding channel projects.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles the display of projects associated with a channel, including pagination.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Processes the form submission to add new projects to a channel.

methods.name: deleteAction
methods.description: Removes a project from a channel based on provided identifiers.

methods.name: createControllerContext
methods.description: Initializes context variables such as list of channels for views.

methods.name: createProjectsForm
methods.description: Creates a form for selecting multiple projects to add to a channel.

methods.name: createChannelProject
methods.description: Associates a project with a channel by creating a NodeProject entry.
